item.text: {"summary":"The current SimpleAtod and SimpleAtof paths explain both failure groups: trailing ASCII whitespace remains unconsumed by from_chars, while removing an initial '+' allows a following '-' to be parsed as a valid sign. The public header confirms floating-point conversions should accept surrounding ASCII whitespace. The supplied implementation and contract are sufficient to identify a concrete repair.","hypotheses":["SimpleAtod rejects trailing whitespace because it checks that from_chars consumed the full string without trimming the suffix.","SimpleAtod and SimpleAtof accept \"+-1\" because they remove the leading '+' but do not reject a second sign before parsing."],"queries":[],"reads":[],"ready":true}
